nodes.description: Address of the contract administrator set in constructor; gates all privileged functions via isAdministrator.
Current boss round number; incremented in startNewBoss and used to index bossData.
Default boss HP used in raw multiplication to derive new boss HP.
Cooldown between attacks, added to block.timestamp for player nextTimeAtk.
Default boss defence stored in newly created BossData.
CryptoEngineerInterface reference used for subVirus, prizePool and claimPrizePool calls.
CryptoMiningWarInterface reference used for addCrystal reward calls.
Mapping of player address to PlayerData (dame, share, win, nextTimeAtk).
Mapping of round number to BossData (hp, def, prizePool, totalDame, playerLastAtk, ended).
Mapping marking whitelisted mini-game contracts.
One-time initialisation flag checked in startGame.
PullPayment mapping of address to credited balance.
PullPayment total credited balance.
Constructor: sets administrator = msg.sender and registers MiningWar and Engineer interfaces.
Payable fallback function that accepts ETH.
Main attack function: consumes virus via Engineer, computes random damage, updates boss and player data, awards crystals and possibly ends the boss.
Private function that finalises a defeated boss, computes ETH bonus/share, emits event and starts a new boss.
Private function that increments bossRoundNumber, computes boss HP and pulls 5% of the engineer prize pool.
Private function updating a player's accumulated ETH share once the current boss round ended.
View function computing a player's share of the boss prize pool.
Public withdrawal of win+share for an arbitrary _addr; transfers ETH then resets state.
View function returning current win+share plus pending calculated share.
Administrator-only upgrade function that selfdestructs sending balance to a given address.
Administrator-only initialisation that sets init true and starts the first boss.
Administrator-only setter for bossRoundNumber.
Administrator-only whitelisting of a mini-game contract after an interface check.
Administrator-only removal of a mini-game contract from the whitelist.
Administrator-only setter validating and storing the CryptoMiningWar interface.
Administrator-only setter validating and storing the CryptoEngineer interface.
PullPayment withdrawal function paying msg.sender their accumulated balance via transfer.
Internal PullPayment credit function adding an amount to a destination address balance.
Private pseudo-random generator based on keccak256 of now, address and nonce.
Private pure helper computing a 5% fee.
Caller-supplied address used as player identity and admin check.
now used for attack cooldown and pseudo-randomness.
Origin address compared to msg.sender in the disableContract modifier.
selfdestruct(addr) in upgrade that irreversibly destroys the contract and sends balance.
_addr.transfer(reward) executed before zeroing player win/share state.
payee.transfer(payment) sending accumulated balance to msg.sender.
External call Engineer.subVirus(msg.sender, _value) to an admin-configurable contract.
External call MiningWar.addCrystal(msg.sender, crystalsBonus) to an admin-configurable contract.
External call Engineer.claimPrizePool(address(this), prizePool) during boss creation.
SafeMath addition with overflow assertion.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath division.
SafeMath minimum helper.
Administrator-only setter for BOSS_DEF_DEFFAULT.
Administrator-only setter for BOSS_HP_DEFAULT.
Administrator-only setter for HALF_TIME_ATK_BOSS.
Virus amount supplied by the attacker to atkBoss.
Recipient address supplied by the caller of withdrawReward.
Player address argument of calculateShareETH.
Round number argument of calculateShareETH.
New round number value passed by the administrator.
Computed attack rate percentage (50-110) from randomNumber.
Attack value derived from _value and rate.
Damage dealt after subtracting boss defence.
Crystal reward equal to 5% of damage dealt.
Flag indicating the boss was killed by this attack.
ETH bonus (5% last-hit bonus plus share) computed in endAtkBoss.
Player proportional share of the prize pool in endAtkBoss.
Total reward (share + win) computed for withdrawal.
New boss HP computed as BOSS_HP_DEFAULT * bossRoundNumber.
Prize pool amount equal to 5% of Engineer.prizePool().
Local alias of msg.sender used as payee in withdrawPayments.
Credited balance read from payments[payee] in withdrawPayments.
Address receiving the contract balance on selfdestruct in upgrade.

edges.reason: upgrade is guarded by isAdministrator requiring msg.sender == administrator.
startGame is guarded by isAdministrator requiring msg.sender == administrator.
setBossRoundNumber is guarded by isAdministrator.
setContractsMiniGame is guarded by isAdministrator.
removeContractMiniGame is guarded by isAdministrator.
setMiningWarInterface is guarded by isAdministrator.
setEngineerInterface is guarded by isAdministrator.
administrator is assigned from msg.sender and compared against msg.sender for privilege checks.
Constructor calls setMiningWarInterface with a hardcoded address.
Constructor calls setEngineerInterface with a hardcoded address.
msg.sender identifies the attacking player and indexes players mapping.
withdrawReward transfers to a caller-supplied _addr without any msg.sender authorisation check.
payee is set to msg.sender in withdrawPayments.
disableContract modifier requires tx.origin == msg.sender, an origin-based authorisation.
now is used for the nextTimeAtk cooldown requirement and for nextTimeAtk updates.
randomNumber mixes now into keccak256, making attack randomness timestamp dependent.
startGame calls startNewBoss to create the first boss.
startGame requires init == false then sets init = true.
Parameter _value is the virus amount consumed in atkBoss.
_value is forwarded directly into the external Engineer.subVirus call.
_value is multiplied by rate to compute atk.
rate is derived from randomNumber(msg.sender, now, 60).
atk = (_value * rate) / 100.
dame is computed by subtracting boss defence from atk.
Computed damage updates bossData[bossRoundNumber].totalDame.
crystalsBonus is 5% of the damage dealt.
crystalsBonus is passed into the MiningWar.addCrystal external call.
isLastHit is derived from bossData totalDame >= bossHp.
endAtkBoss is invoked when isLastHit is true.
atkBoss triggers endAtkBoss when the boss HP is fully depleted.
atkBoss calls updateShareETH for the attacking player.
updateShareETH calls calculateShareETH.
External call into the admin-configurable Engineer contract via subVirus.
External call into the admin-configurable MiningWar contract via addCrystal.
MiningWar interface state is used to reward crystals during an attack.
Engineer interface state is used to consume virus during an attack.
endAtkBoss calls startNewBoss after finishing the round.
share is computed from prizePool, player dame and total dame.
ethBonus is augmented with the computed share.
getCurrentReward calls calculateShareETH for the pending share.
withdrawReward calls updateShareETH before paying.
Arbitrary _addr parameter determines who receives the withdrawal.
Computed reward is sent out through the ETH transfer.
Caller-controlled _addr is the transfer recipient.
ETH is transferred to an external address before win/share are zeroed, allowing state reuse.
payee (msg.sender) is the recipient of the transfer.
payment is the amount transferred out.
ETH transfer out to msg.sender after state is updated in withdrawPayments.
selfdestruct sends the whole balance to the administrator-supplied address.
BOSS_HP_DEFAULT participates in an unchecked raw multiplication.
bossHp = BOSS_HP_DEFAULT * bossRoundNumber is raw multiplication outside SafeMath, overflow possible.
prizePool local is assigned into the new BossData struct.
Engineer.prizePool() is read to compute the claimed prize pool.
startNewBoss makes an external claimPrizePool call into the Engineer contract.
The claimed prize pool is recorded in local prizePool.
BOSS_DEF_DEFFAULT is stored into the new BossData.
bossRoundNumber is incremented and used to index the new boss.
bossData[bossRoundNumber] is read and written during an attack.
bossData storage is mutated with totalDame and playerLastAtk.
players[msg.sender] is read and updated with dame and nextTimeAtk.
HALF_TIME_ATK_BOSS is added to now for the next attack time.
miniGames[_addr] is set to true when whitelisting a mini-game.
SafeMath.mul is used for the 5% prize pool computation.
SafeMath.div is used for the 5% prize pool computation.
SafeMath.add sums share and win into reward.
payments[payee] is read and zeroed during withdrawal.
asyncSend credits payments[dest].
asyncSend writes the increased balance back to the payments mapping.
totalPayments is decremented by the payment amount.
Parameter _value is written directly into bossRoundNumber.
Parameter _bossRoundNumber indexes bossData inside calculateShareETH.
Parameter _addr indexes the players mapping inside calculateShareETH.
Parameter _addr is the destination that receives the selfdestructed balance.
SafeMath.sub is used to derive damage from attack minus defence.
SafeMath.min caps totalDame at bossHp to prevent excess accumulation.

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter only exists to drive the atkBoss entry point.
The _addr parameter is only meaningful inside withdrawReward.
The _addr parameter is only used to index players in calculateShareETH.
The round-number parameter is only used to index bossData in calculateShareETH.
The _value parameter is stored straight into bossRoundNumber by the setter.
The _addr parameter is consumed by the selfdestruct in upgrade.
rate is a short-lived intermediate of the atkBoss computation.
atk is an intermediate damage value inside atkBoss.
dame is an intermediate damage value inside atkBoss.
crystalsBonus is only produced to be forwarded to the MiningWar reward call.
isLastHit solely decides whether endAtkBoss runs.
ethBonus is computed only for the endAtkBoss event and payout accounting.
share is computed only inside endAtkBoss.
reward is the exact value passed into the ETH transfer in withdrawReward.
bossHp is a temporary computed in startNewBoss.
prizePool is a temporary computed in startNewBoss.
payee is only an alias of msg.sender used as the transfer recipient.
payment is the exact amount passed into the transfer in withdrawPayments.
